issues.description: The method addGuestStudents has a parameter-type contradiction across the exercise artifacts: problem_statement.md (line 50) instructs students to implement addGuestStudents(String), while the class UML in problem_statement.md (line 73) and the reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java (line 90) define addGuestStudents(int). This inconsistency leaves students unsure which signature to implement and can lead to compilation/test mismatches or incorrect submissions.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across all materials. Preferred fix: update problem_statement.md to specify addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and reference solution. Additionally, update the template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to include a clear stub or comment with the intended signature (e.g., public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)) so students have an unambiguous implementation target. If the original intent was to accept a String, then instead update the UML and reference solution to use String and adjust tests accordingly.
